current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: sixteenth-note syncopated pocket with strong one, interlocking drums/bass/guitar and intentional rests
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: short riff-based phrases, breaks, vamps and call-response cells
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: vamp-based harmony, dominant/minor-seventh color and static harmony common; harmonic complexity serves groove
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: highly syncopated electric bass with ghost/rest space and strong relationship to kick
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: tight kick/snare/hats with ghost-note and syncopation possibilities; fills do not break pocket
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: electric bass, clean rhythmic guitar, drums, clav/EP/synth target, horns optional
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: all rhythm parts interlock; no one part fills every subdivision
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: vamp sections, breaks, horn hits and density changes rather than long harmonic forms
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: short guitar attacks, bass accents, horn stabs, tight drum articulation
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: microtiming shared by pocket; often slightly laid-back subdivisions without random drift
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: velocity/articulation and filter/modulation where target resources support them
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: dry/tight core with selective wah/filter/room effects
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: bass and kick prominent; guitar/keys occupy separate rhythmic slots
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: punchy, dry-to-warm master; preserve transient contrast
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires responsive bass/guitar/drum voices and optional clav/EP/horn targets
